keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Eric Kitolano (Lillestrøm).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Lillestrøm 0, Viktoria Plzen 1. Prince Adu (Viktoria Plzen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Patrik Hrosovsky with a through ball.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Lars Ranger (Lillestrøm) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Sampson Dweh (Viktoria Plzen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
